audit_log.value: I run a small mobile car detailing business and need a professional monthly service agreement for a client with two family vehicles. We originally agreed to one wash per month, but now they often request interior deep cleans, pet hair removal, stain treatment, headlight restoration, and last-minute add-on visits before trips or events. Payment timing has become inconsistent and they sometimes ask for extra work without confirming price first. I need something clean and modern that clearly defines the monthly plan, what services are included, pricing for add-ons, approval required before extra work begins, scheduling windows, cancellation notice, access to the vehicles, responsibility for personal items left inside, weather rescheduling, photo permission for before/after results, and a simple way for both sides to review changes and sign online.
